title: Tunisian Yellow Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew from Tunisia, featuring yellow beans and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the soaked and drained yellow beans, tagine spice blend, and cumin to the pot.
Stir to combine, then add 2 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
While the stew simmers, cook the white rice according to package instructions.
Once the stew has finished cooking, season with salt to taste.
Serve the stew over the cooked rice.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
